title: Pointer Network Run-004: Analysis, Bug Hunting, and Pathfinding
scope: 20 agents across 3 divisions: 8 analysis, 4 bug hunting, 8 pathfinding

A1_tools.summary: Evaluated D3.js, Cytoscape.js, Gephi, NetworkX, Neo4j, node2vec for compatibility
A1_tools.top_recommendation: Cytoscape.js for interactive visualization, NetworkX for analysis, Neo4j for querying

A2_workflow.summary: Designed 5 integration patterns: pre-task routing, live navigation, post-task learning, coordinator integration, help protocol integration
A2_workflow.key_design: Agents should consult pointer network before every task and log routes after

A3_usecases.summary: Identified 6 applications: knowledge discovery, onboarding, impact analysis, QA, cross-project, market research

A4_algorithms.summary: Designed community detection, PageRank, link prediction, RL-based weight update, and pruning strategies

A5_queryapi.summary: Built PointerNetworkQuery class with find_path, neighbors, search, impact, suggest_edges methods

A6_monitoring.summary: Designed 6 health metrics with alerting rules and dashboard integration

A7_autoclassify.summary: Auto-classified all 3,931 unclassified edges to reach 100% coverage
